job.title: Mortgage Collections Officer (0-30 day accounts)

This opportunity would suit someone who enjoys structured targets, meaningful customer interaction and working within a supportive financial services team.

To be successful in this opportunity, you will bring the following experience and qualities:
  • Minimum 18 months’ collections experience within financial services OR 18 months customer service experience within a financial services environment
  • Confidence managing sensitive conversations regarding overdue accounts
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational ability
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to quickly integrate into an established team
  • Comfortable handling 60-80 outbound calls daily 
  • Availability to commence immediately or at short notice will be highly regarded

Email your résumé to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or call Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation.

Our client is a respected NSW organisation dedicated to delivering programs and initiatives that support the growth and development of the contemporary music industry across the state.

They are seeking an experienced and passionate Project Coordinator for an immediate start on a contract through to 27 February 2027. The role is based in their Sydney CBD office, with hybrid working arrangements available.


The Job
Reporting to the Project Manager, in this Project Coordinator, Music role you will be responsible for:
  • Coordinate projects to deliver agency outcomes within agreed scope.
  • Prepare, review and track reports, briefs, governance papers and presentations, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key industry stakeholders, providing relevant advice and information.
  • Manage project administration and documentation to support transparency and effective policy delivery.
  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of agency programs and initiatives.
  • Provide project advice, identify risks and support effective outcomes.
  
You
To be successful in this role, you must have experience in the following:
  • Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Project Coordinator role within the government sector.
  • Strong knowledge of and experience in the contemporary music industry.
  • Proven experience engaging with diverse stakeholders across industry, government and community sectors.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications or equivalent professional experience.
 
How to apply
Our client is searching for a candidate who has a driven and can-do attitude. Please send your application via our job search. 

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Risk Analyst | Enterprise Risk, Compliance and Advisory
job.description:
The Company…..
A well established Australian financial services business with multiple licensed entities is entering its next phase of growth. The risk, legal and compliance function is evolving to a true enterprise risk model. The team reports directly into the board and has a clear governance mandate. You will join a group of solid, hard working people with deep experience across lending, settlements and originations.

The Job…..
This is an analyst level role with a strong advisory leaning. You will sit at the centre of the team's regulatory, assurance and reporting work, turning complex obligations into clear and practical insight for the business and the board.
  • Prepare and support ASIC reporting, and help the business understand what the requirements mean in practice
  • Synthesise information from across the business into clear insight and reporting for senior stakeholders
  • Support licensing, obligations management, assurance and advisory projects
  • Work with the data and insights capability in the team, understanding how data comes together, including IDR and EDR reporting
  • Contribute to a team that is looking to leverage AI and analytics to lift the quality of risk reporting
  • Partner with colleagues across assurance, internal audit, AML and fraud, and collections quality assurance
You…..
  • Hands on ASIC reporting experience, with the ability to interpret regulatory requirements in a commercial setting and not just in theory
  • A good working knowledge of the Australian regulatory landscape for lending and credit, including collections and hardship
  • A background in risk, compliance, assurance, advisory or internal audit within financial services
  • Comfortable working with data, reporting tools and metrics, and confident presenting insights clearly
  • Able to thrive in an environment with a high level of change, and to bring a practical, solutions focused approach
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with stakeholders at all levels
How to apply…..
If you're an analyst with ASIC reporting experience who can turn regulation into practical commercial insight for the board, this is a chance to shape a risk function as it moves to an enterprise model. Apply via the link or contact Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation. All applications are treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Software Developer - Gold Coast
job.description:
The Company…..
Our client is a highly regarded Australian business with an established market presence and a strong industry reputation. As they continue to invest in digital transformation, they are growing their close knit technology team and looking for an early career developer who wants to learn fast and build real solutions from day one.
You will be supported by experienced developers who care about helping you grow, while working on projects that matter to the business.

The Job…..
As a Software Developer, you will work across a modern technology stack, contributing to new development and the ongoing evolution of core business systems. You will:
  • Build and maintain full stack applications using React and modern backend technologies
  • Help develop and support custom APIs, an in house CRM platform and new Point of Sale (POS) functionality
  • Learn to build serverless, event driven solutions using Azure Functions and cloud native services
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of CRM data structures
  • Take on increasing ownership of projects and technical decisions as your skills grow
  • Work closely with a small, friendly and highly engaged internal technology team, with regular code reviews and mentoring
You…..
You do not need to tick every box. Our client is looking for strong foundations and a genuine passion for building software.

Essential:
  • Up to 2 years’ commercial experience as a Full Stack or Backend Developer (graduates, internship and project experience will be considered)
  • Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, with hands on React experience
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Familiarity with Git and pull request workflows
  • A curious, pragmatic mindset, good communication skills and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code
  • The ability to work in the Gold Coast office five days a week
Nice to have (on the job training available):
  • Exposure to Azure Functions or equivalent AWS or GCP serverless services
  • Awareness of OAuth2 and token based authentication, including MSAL or Microsoft Entra ID
  • Azure DevOps experience
What’s On Offer…..
  • Mentoring and hands on guidance from experienced developers
  • Genuine exposure to modern cloud and serverless technologies
  • A clear path to more ownership and influence over technical direction
  • A stable and growing Australian business investing in technology
  • Long term career growth within a supportive team culture
How to apply….
This position is based full time onsite at the company’s Gold Coast office. Please only apply if you are able to commit to working onsite five days per week.
To apply, click the Apply button or contact Jenny Quigley at SB Recruitment on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Experienced Jeweller - CAD/CAM Production Coordinator
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a leading Australian jewellery manufacturer renowned for its quality craftsmanship, innovation, and exceptional customer service. Combining traditional techniques with advanced manufacturing technology, they deliver end to end jewellery production solutions to a broad network of retail jewellers and industry partners across Australia.
Operating from a modern manufacturing facility in Marrickville, their commitment to precision, efficiency, and continuous improvement has established them as a trusted name within the Australian jewellery industry.
With a collaborative and supportive culture, the company values teamwork, technical excellence, and ongoing professional development.

The Job
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in coordinating the workflow of CAD and CAM projects from initial customer enquiry through to production. This is not an entry-level or trainee position — it requires someone with genuine jewellery manufacturing experience who can read a job with a jeweller's eye and make sound production calls.

You will be responsible for the following duties:
  • Reviewing and interpreting client product briefs, drawing on your own manufacturing knowledge to assess what's actually required.
  • Identifying and obtaining any missing technical or production information directly from clients.
  • Translating client requirements into a clear, comprehensive manufacturing brief.
  • Determining and coordinating the most appropriate production pathway — whether local bespoke manufacturing, offshore production, laser cutting, hand fabrication, or coin pressing.
  • Allocating CAD work to internal and external drafting resources.
  • Coordinating communication between customers, CAD drafters, CAM operators, and production teams.
  • Monitoring job progress, following up on revisions, approvals, and production timelines.
  • Maintaining accurate job records and documentation within internal systems.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and support continuous process improvement.
You
This role is suited to an experienced jeweller looking to transition from a hands-on bench role into a broader operational or project coordination position — leveraging your industry expertise while advancing your career. To be successful, you will bring:
  • A solid, demonstrated background in jewellery manufacturing.
  • The confidence to interpret technical specifications and make informed production pathway decisions based on real manufacturing knowledge.
  • Strong computer and administrative skills, or a genuine willingness to build on them.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple jobs simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and relationship building skills, with the confidence to liaise with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
How to Apply
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced jeweller to step into a varied and rewarding coordination role within a supportive, collaborative team. To apply, submit your application to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or contact Jenny Quigley on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential discussion.
